notes.title: Update 5.33
notes.content: [p]Scripts are sets of instructions used to create interactive animations. For example, you can create clickable buttons and assign actions for them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How to use scrips?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Open Layers toolbar[/p][/*][*][p]Select a layer[/p][/*][*][p]Open Layer menu[/p][/*][*][p]Press Script manager[/p][/*][*][p]Create a new script with Script builder[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 2.51
notes.content: Update 2.51 introduces some important features. Now you can use arrow keys for precise selection movement, this can be useful for animation. Also I've added 'Click & Hold' feature to pick colors. Palette max size was incereased up to 256, so you can now import any giant palettes from Lospec.
